⚡ Verdis VM Instruction Set Reference (22 Instructions)

Complete opcode list for lower-level assembly optimization on Verdis execution layer.
Opcode Mnemonic Gas Cost Description
0x01PUSH2 GasPush constant 256-bit word onto stack
0x02POP2 GasRemove top word from stack
0x03ADD3 GasInteger addition (a + b)
0x04SUB3 GasInteger subtraction (a - b)
0x05MUL5 GasInteger multiplication (a * b)
0x06DIV5 GasInteger division with zero-check
0x10SLOAD100 GasLoad word from persistent contract storage
0x11SSTORE500 GasSave word into persistent contract storage
0x20JUMP8 GasUnconditional program counter jump
0x21JUMPI10 GasConditional program counter jump
0x30CALL700 GasExternal message call to target address
0x31DELEGATECALL700 GasCall external code preserving storage context
0x40CREATE32,000 GasInstantiate new contract on Verdis VM
0x41REVERT0 GasHalt execution and revert state changes
0x50LOG0375 GasEmit raw protocol event log entry
0x60BALANCE400 GasQuery native VRD balance of given account
0x61GAS2 GasFetch remaining gas allocation in frame
0x62BLOCKHASH20 GasFetch hash of specified block height
0x70EMIT_ECO_SCORE150 GasRecord node sustainability efficiency rating
0x71MINT_CARBON1,200 GasMint verified carbon offset certificate token
0x72VERIFY_PROOF2,500 GasValidate Zero-Knowledge succinct proof
0xFFHALT0 GasTerminate execution frame successfully
